blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Reviewed all three issuer-directory deployments. Near-contemporaneous pinned totalSupply reads give Polygon 4156202969.754852048213337676 COPM (97.2400%), Celo 102966114.628110192879069442 (2.4090%) and Solana 15000000 (0.3509%), denominator 4274169084.382962241092407118 COPM across all three chains; these are measured issued-supply shares, not a circulating-supply override. Polygon is the decisive material deployment. At Polygon block 97385031 and Celo block 82882338 (hashes/times in source labels), current getImplementation() matches verified TokenV1 source; FREEZER_ROLE has exactly one live member, the issuer Safe, also DEFAULT_ADMIN. TokenV1.freeze(address) and thaw(address) set holder-specific state; _beforeTokenTransfer rejects frozen sender/recipient; burnFrozen(address,uint256) destroys an arbitrary frozen holder balance. Direct targeted controls therefore establish Yes, regardless of upgrade exposure. On Solana exact finalized slot 469903332, freezeAuthority and permanentDelegate both name the same Squads V4 vault PDA as mint authority, cryptographically derived from its exact multisig account (2-of-7, zero time lock, no config-authority override); Token-2022 permits account freeze and delegated holder transfers/burns. Celo and Solana are individually below the materiality threshold and do not determine the verdict. Off-chain key custody remains unverified.

nativeInventoryReview.rationale: The issuer directory enumerates Polygon, Celo and Solana, and all three exact identities were reviewed. Both current EVM implementations expose arbitrary-recipient role-gated minting, while exact-slot Token-2022 state assigns native mint authority to an issuer Squads V4 vault with a current 2-of-7 multisig and a historical native MintToChecked execution. BDO independently counts token liabilities across all three chains. Minteo API bridge documentation describes issuer-operated cross-chain transfers with burn_transaction and mint_and_transfer_transaction fields; this is separate service machinery, not evidence that any catalog deployment is a wrapped representation. No external validator, escrow or message-proof gate was established; precise backend execution and bridge accounting remain undocumented.
